name: ETCUSDT_funding_dispersion_paper_seed_proposal
notes: Research Track 트랙 F 6번째 R-5 후보. funding rate cross-section z-score reversal. Universe: 14 paper-pool symbols. Distinct from funding_carry (per-symbol time-series z) and autocorr_regime (price autocorr). R-3 perm_p=0.0000 (200/200), 4/5 정량 cutoff (alpha 138/150=92%, sharpe 3.50, mdd 6.07, wr 70.27, PF 3.72, trades 37). Outperforms all 5 currently-seeded sessions (HBAR/AXS/COMP funding_carry + LINK/UNI autocorr_regime) jointly on sharpe/mdd/wr/pf. ETC is paradigm-special — at same spec other 13 symbols sharpe mean -0.07 (per-symbol 1:1 fit).
data_source: binance_funding_rate table (14-symbol cross-section z-score at each 8h funding boundary)

metrics_summary.comment: Real alpha 138 vs random shuffle mean 22 — 6× ratio. 200/200 random shuffles below real alpha. WF not run (master plan §3 marks it optional after perm). Cross-section z-signal isolated from price-PnL via shuffle test.

comparison_to_seeded.vs_HBAR_funding_carry_v4: ETC sharpe 3.50 vs HBAR 1.87 (1.9x); mdd 6.07 vs 9.57 (lower risk); wr 70 vs 68
comparison_to_seeded.vs_AXS_funding_carry_v4: ETC alpha 138 vs AXS 148 (-7%); sharpe 3.50 vs 1.48 (2.4x); mdd 6.07 vs 14.45 (less than half)
comparison_to_seeded.vs_LINK_autocorr_regime: ETC alpha 138 vs LINK 116 (+19%); sharpe 3.50 vs 1.25 (2.8x); PF 3.72 vs 3.33

research_lineage.anti_pattern_check: Hurst-trap not present at ez=0.8 (37 trades, well above rare-event boundary). xs_z signal preserved through price-shuffle perm test (signal independent of price path).

implementation_path.source_class_needed: BinanceFundingDispersionSource (new) — at each 8h boundary, computes xs_z across universe and emits per-symbol z-score signal
implementation_path.composer: PassthroughComposer (reuse from autocorr_regime seed) or NegationPassthroughComposer (reuse from funding_carry seed)
implementation_path.policy: FundingDispersionPolicy (new) or reuse FundingReversalPolicy with xs_z input — needs entry/exit threshold + max_hold + SL hooks
implementation_path.cron: binance-paper-cycle (existing) — funding rate already backfilled daily
